templates.title: GameVault
templates.name: gamevault
templates.description: GameVault 17.0.1 is a self-hosted library for DRM-free games, with a web UI and PostgreSQL.

env.name: DB_HOST
env.label: DB_HOST
env.description: PostgreSQL hostname. Must be the database service name.

env.name: DB_PASSWORD
env.label: DB_PASSWORD
env.description: PostgreSQL password. Must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD and must not be empty.

env.name: POSTGRES_USER
env.label: POSTGRES_USER
env.description: PostgreSQL user for the gamevault-db service.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.description: PostgreSQL password for the gamevault-db service.
